annotations.title: Run a study against a synthetic panel

description: Starts a background run: every person on the panel answers the study (or, for kind interview, sits with the study's interviewer). Spends workspace credit — give the person the estimate from prism_panel_runs_estimate first. Works on draft studies. Answers land as their own result set, labeled synthetic, never counted as responses. Follow with prism_panel_runs_get. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

budgetUsd.description: Pause the run once it has spent this many dollars.

interviewFocus.description: Interview runs: what the interviewer should explore.

samples.description: Answers per person for a survey run (default 3).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: prism_panels_run
title: Run a study against a synthetic panel
